# Zain Ventures India

> Zain Ventures India runs a daily AC bus between Rourkela (Odisha) and Patna (Bihar), and hires out buses and cars. Based in Rourkela.

## Services

### 1. Rourkela ⇄ Patna bus tickets
- Stops: Rourkela, Gumla, Chatra, Gaya, Patna.
- Runs daily in both directions.
- AC bus with 2+2 pushback seats.
- Times and fares: on the booking page.
- Book online: https://fleetmanager.pythonanywhere.com/tickets/zain-ventures-india/
- Or call or WhatsApp +91 93370 00323.

### 2. Bus and car hire
- AC and non-AC buses, 20 to 50 seats.
- Sedans and SUVs.
- For weddings, tours, pilgrimages and corporate trips.
- Call or WhatsApp +91 93370 00323 with the date, route and group size.
